# Morse Code Translator

Free browser-based Morse code translator at translatorcodemorse.com. Convert text to Morse and Morse to text in linked panels, with audio playback (Play/Pause/Stop/Repeat, WPM and Farnsworth speed, CW or telegraph sound), tap input, on-device microphone decoding (Listen mode), a contained dock flash indicator, optional vibration, WAV download, share/puzzle links, and a built-in alphabet reference. Everything runs locally in the browser — no account and no upload of what you type or record.

## Pages

- [Home](https://translatorcodemorse.com/): Interactive translator with Text/Morse panels, audio, tap, and mic modes
- [Morse code alphabet](https://translatorcodemorse.com/morse-code-alphabet/): Letter chart and learning notes for International Morse
- [Morse code numbers](https://translatorcodemorse.com/morse-code-numbers/): Digit chart and tips for sending numbers
- [SOS in Morse code](https://translatorcodemorse.com/sos-in-morse-code/): What SOS is, how it sounds and looks, and how to practice it
- [About](https://translatorcodemorse.com/about/): What the tool does, privacy model, and who it is for
- [Privacy](https://translatorcodemorse.com/privacy/): How the site handles data (processing stays in your browser)
- [Contact](https://translatorcodemorse.com/contact/): How to reach the site owner
